summary: Tamil Nadu mourns the passing of veteran chef K. Damodaran, known widely as Chef Damu, while authorities step up monsoon alerts as a depression over the Bay of Bengal triggers heavy rains and cyclone warnings across coastal districts. Meanwhile, the state government has issued orders for 50,000 new agricultural power connections and announced a major housing scheme.

stories.headline: Celebrity Chef Damu Passes Away at 72
stories.summary: Padma Shri awardee and beloved television culinary judge K. Damodaran has passed away in Chennai at the age of 72 following health complications. Chief Minister Vijay and other leaders offered deep condolences.

stories.headline: Cyclone Warning: Nine TN Ports on Alert
stories.summary: As a depression over the Bay of Bengal intensifies, authorities have hoisted distant cautionary signal number 1 at nine ports across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. Fishermen have been strictly advised to stay off the sea.
stories.key_fact: System likely to cross Andhra coast

stories.headline: TN Government Clears 50,000 Free Power Links
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has issued an official order to provide 50,000 new free agricultural electricity connections, with the state bearing an additional financial commitment of Rs 127 crore.

stories.headline: Housing Push: 12,648 New Homes Announced
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has announced a major housing initiative to construct 12,648 new residential units across various districts to benefit urban and rural families, allocating substantial funds for the project.

stories.headline: Ex-Army Captain Arrested for Espionage
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Police have arrested a retired Army captain near Vellore for allegedly leaking confidential military intelligence to a foreign operative via messaging applications over the past year.

stories.headline: Chennai Police Issue LOC in Gem Granites Case
stories.summary: Chennai Police have issued Look Out Circulars restraining five suspects, linked to the Gem Granites Veeramani POCSO case, from leaving the country as investigations into multiple abuse charges continue.

stories.headline: CPI Launches Campaign Against New Secretariat
stories.summary: The Communist Party of India has launched a signature campaign opposing the state government's proposed new Secretariat building project at Pattinapakkam, citing environmental and local fishermen concerns.

stories.headline: MTC Wins National Urban Transport Award
stories.summary: The Metropolitan Transport Corporation has bagged a prestigious national award recognizing its innovative approaches and efficiency in urban transport financing and fleet management.

stories.headline: TN Eyeing Second Successive Win at Home
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu’s cricket team under head coach Yo Mahesh is geared up to face Railways in the Ranji Trophy match, aiming for a strong performance despite looming weather disruptions.

stories.headline: Madras University Plans Portal Security Upgrade
stories.summary: Following multiple cyber intrusions over the past few months, the University of Madras has initiated comprehensive plans to upgrade its web portals and strengthen digital security frameworks.
